findings.title: Sources import ".ts" paths, which the project's tsconfig does not allow
findings.why: tsconfig.json (strict, NodeNext, declaration, outDir) has no allowImportingTsExtensions or rewriteRelativeImportExtensions, so tsc rejects the "./x.ts" imports in src/*.ts. The sources also use structuredClone with no @types/node or DOM lib configured. `node --test` strips types, so only a type check or build would fail. Found by reading the config and the imports, not by running tsc.
